credential_type.quote: The board shall issue a license as a certified public accountant to a person who submits the application required by the board, pays the fee as set under section 12203 and meets the qualifications set forth in section 12228.

is_mandatory.quote: No person holding a certificate may engage in the practice of public accountancy, unless that person also holds a valid license issued under this chapter.

title_protection.quote: No person not licensed as a certified public accountant under this chapter may use or assume the title of "certified public accountant," the abbreviation "CPA" or any other title, designation, words, letters, abbreviation, sign, card or device indicating that the person is a certified public accountant.

scope_protection.quote: A person or firm not holding a valid license issued under this chapter may not issue a report, including reviews and compilations, on financial statements or on any attest service of any other person, firm, organization or governmental unit.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Cancellation, revocation, suspension or refusal to renew authority to practice in any other state.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Cancellation, revocation, suspension or refusal to renew authority to engage in the practice of public accountancy in any other state for any cause

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to maintain compliance with requirements for issuance or renewal of license or to report required changes.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure, on the part of an applicant or a licensee to maintain compliance with the requirements for issuance or renewal of that license or to report the changes to the board required by section 12252, subsection 6

disciplinary_grounds.description: Revocation or suspension of the right to practice before any state or federal agency.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Revocation or suspension of the right to practice before any state or federal agency

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dishonesty, fraud or gross negligence in the practice of public accountancy or in filing or failure to file own income tax returns.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dishonesty, fraud or gross negligence in the practice of public accountancy or in the filing or failure to file the licensee's own income tax returns

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performance of any fraudulent act while holding a license or certificate.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performance of any fraudulent act while holding a license issued under this chapter or a certificate or license issued under prior law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any conduct reflecting adversely upon the licensee's fitness to engage in the practice of public accountancy.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any conduct reflecting adversely upon the licensee's fitness to engage in the practice of public accountancy.

definition_quote.value: "Practice of or practicing public accountancy" means the following combined activities by a person or firm: A. Representing to the public that the person or the firm is a licensee; and B. Performing or offering to perform, for a client or potential client, services involving the use of accounting or auditing skills.

value: furnishing of advice on tax matters
methods_authorized.quote: Accounting or auditing skills include the issuance of reports, management advisory or consulting services, the preparation of tax returns and the furnishing of advice on tax matters.

value: Any audit or other engagement performed in accordance with the Statements on Auditing Standards (SAS)

attest_services_types.quote: "Attest service" means providing the following services: A. Any audit or other engagement to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Auditing Standards, SAS; B. Any review of a financial statement or compilation of a financial statement to be performed in accordance with the Statement on Standards for Accounting and Review Services, SSARS; C. Any examination of prospective financial information to be performed in accordance with the Statement on Standards for Attestation Engagements, SSAE; D. Any engagement to be performed in accordance with the auditing standards of the Public Company Accounting Oversight Board; F. Any examination, review or agreed upon procedures engagement to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Standards for Attestation Engagements, SSAE, other than an engagement described in paragraph C.

compilation_services_authorized.quote: Any review of a financial statement or compilation of a financial statement to be performed in accordance with the Statement on Standards for Accounting and Review Services, SSARS

education_semester_hours_required.quote: At least 150 semester hours of education, including a minimum 4-year baccalaureate or higher degree conferred by a college or university acceptable to the board

exam_sit_hours_minimum.quote: An examination applicant who has successfully completed at least 120 semester hours of education, including the basic courses in accounting and auditing required by paragraph B, and who expects to complete a minimum 4-year baccalaureate or higher degree required in paragraph B is eligible to take the examination.

practice_privilege_no_notice_required.quote: may provide professional services in the State without the requirement to obtain a license under this section or to otherwise notify or register with the board or pay any fee

value: Consent to personal and subject matter jurisdiction and disciplinary authority of the board
Comply with the provisions of this chapter and the board's rules
Cessation of practice if home-state license is no longer valid
practice_privilege_consent_conditions.quote: An individual licensee of another state exercising the practice privilege afforded under this section and the firm that employs that individual must consent, as a condition of the grant of the practice privilege: A. To the personal and subject matter jurisdiction and disciplinary authority of the board; B. To comply with the provisions of this chapter and the board's rules; and C. To the stipulation that, in the event the license from the state of the individual's principal place of business is no longer valid, the individual will cease offering or rendering professional services in the State

attest_services_require_firm_permit.quote: An individual who qualifies for the practice privilege under this section may perform any of the services listed in section 12201, subsection 3‑A for any entity with its home office in the State as long as the individual does so through a firm that has obtained a license issued under section 12252

firm_majority_cpa_ownership_required.quote: a simple majority of the ownership of the firm, in terms of financial interests and voting rights of all partners, officers, shareholders, members or managers, belongs to certified public accountants or public accountants who are licensed in a state

nonlicensee_firm_owners_permitted.quote: A certified public accountancy firm or public accountancy firm may include nonlicensee owners as long as: (1) All nonlicensee owners are individuals who actively participate in the certified public accountancy firm or public accountancy firm or an affiliated entity

peer_review_required_for_firm_renewal.quote: As a condition to the granting or renewal of licenses to certified public accountancy firms, each applicant that provides an attest service other than compilations must successfully participate in an approved peer review program.

peer_review_max_frequency_years.quote: The firm must undergo a peer review every 3 years for as long as it provides an attest service other than compilations.

out_of_state_firm_no_office_exemption.quote: A firm that does not have an office in this State may perform services described in section 12201, subsection 3‑A, paragraph B or F for a client having its home office in this State and may use the title "CPA" or "CPA firm" without a license issued under this section only if: (1) It qualifies for a firm license pursuant to subsections 3 and 8 and it performs such services through an individual with practice privileges under section 12232

office_supervision_by_licensed_cpa_requi.quote: each such office is under the charge of a person holding a valid license issued under section 12230 or 12231 or a corresponding provision of prior law or the laws of another state.

client_confidentiality_privilege.quote: a licensee or any partner, officer, shareholder or employee of a licensee may not voluntarily disclose information communicated to the licensee, or any partner, officer, shareholder or employee of the licensee, by the client relating to, and in connection with, services rendered to the client by the licensee in the practice of public accountancy. That information must be considered confidential

working_papers_ownership_by_licensee.quote: All statements, records, schedules, working papers and memoranda made by a licensee or a partner, shareholder, officer, director or employee of a licensee, incident to, or in the course of, rendering services to a client in the practice of public accountancy, except the reports submitted by the licensee to the client and except for records that are part of the client's records, shall be and remain the property of the licensee in the absence of an express agreement between the licensee and the client to the contrary.

commission_prohibition_during_attest.quote: A licensee, when performing for a client an attest service, may not receive a commission or a referral fee

contingent_fee_prohibition_during_attest.quote: When involved in providing for a client an attest service: (1) Perform for a contingent fee any services for a client; or (2) Receive a contingency fee from a client

foreign_accountant_practice_exception.quote: Subsections 1 to 11 do not apply to a person or firm holding a certificate, designation, degree or license granted in a foreign country entitling the holder to engage in the practice of public accountancy or its equivalent in that country, whose activities in this State are limited to the provision of professional services to persons or firms who are residents of, governments of or business entities of the country in which that person holds that entitlement

single_act_evidence_sufficient.quote: evidence from the commission of a single act prohibited by this chapter is sufficient to justify a penalty, injunction, restraining order or conviction, respectively, without evidence of a general course of conduct.

firm_permit_required_for_attest_services.quote: A firm must hold a license issued under this section if it: (1) Has an office in this State performing any of the services described in section 12201, subsection 3‑A, paragraphs A to D

accounting_practitioner_tier.quote: No new public accountant licenses may be issued by the board on or after the effective date of this section.

client_records_return_obligation.quote: A licensee shall furnish to his client or former client upon request and reasonable notice: A. A copy of the licensee's working papers, to the extent that the working papers include records that would ordinarily constitute part of the client's records and are not otherwise available to the client; and B. Any accounting or other records belonging to, or obtained from or on behalf of, the client that the licensee removed from the client's premises or received for the client's account.
